$comment: Product safety warnings for the product-page safety block (GPSR (EU) 2023/988 Art. 19). Only approved statements from the Incutec safety leaflet (document DOC-SAFETY-OPENDRONE) are copied in here, unchanged, per product family and language. While approved is false the block keeps the existing gpsr_warnings_<kind>_<lang> copy lines; once approved is true and documentVersion names the approved leaflet version, the block shows these statements instead.
